methodNote.en: This is an original analytical digest, not the novel’s text or a translation of any edition. No EPUB/FB2/PDF edition of The Hobbit was found in the checked local library; the full novel was neither read nor downloaded. The event structure was compared with the public publisher chapter guide for chapters 1–19, but that guide is not the novel and does not verify every detail; unsupported specifics are omitted. Context was checked against Tolkien Estate, an archival finding aid and bibliography. No page references or verbatim quotations are claimed. “Book” identifies reported events or imagery; “Context” identifies external evidence; “Synthesis” identifies our interpretation. Essential is substantially spoiler-light; Core reveals episodes; only Deep contains the full resolution. External sources may themselves contain spoilers.
